shared_elements: bearded human figures in strict profile
procession of animals in profile moving in one direction
low relief carving with figures overlapping in file
human figure leading/holding an animal by a tether or rein
stylized patterned hair/beard rendered as regular rows of curls
ground line with figures aligned along it
justification: Both are low-relief friezes of bearded profile figures moving rightward with animals led on cords, animals overlapping in file above a ground line, and both use the same convention of tightly patterned rows of curls for hair and beard and profile heads with frontal-set eye. The subject differs, however: A is a peaceful tribute procession of attendants with rams and a bull below a rosette border, while B is a chariot drawn by a horse with an armed driver trampling a fallen body, a violent military scene with a spoked wheel and harness poles absent from A.
